dz: 忏悔者爱德华成为英格兰国王——该国倒数第二位盎格鲁撒克逊国王。
de: Edward the Confessor becomes King of England – the country's penultimate Anglo-Saxon king.

t: 维京人突袭了诺森布里亚的林地斯法恩修道院,被公认为是英国各岛诺斯活动的起步.
te: Vikings raid the abbey at Lindisfarne in Northumbria, commonly accepted as the beginning of Norse activity in the Briti…
dz: 维京人突袭了诺森布里亚的林地斯法恩修道院,被公认为是英国各岛诺斯活动的起步.
de: Vikings raid the abbey at Lindisfarne in Northumbria, commonly accepted as the beginning of Norse activity in the British Isles.

t: 当年早些时候阿加佩图斯一世教皇去世后,选举了西尔维尤斯教皇.
te: Election of pope Silverius following the death of pope Agapetus I earlier that year.
dz: 当年早些时候阿加佩图斯一世教皇去世后,选举了西尔维尤斯教皇.
de: Election of pope Silverius following the death of pope Agapetus I earlier that year.

t: 阿提拉率领一支匈奴军队入侵了意大利,在他向罗马行进时摧毁了北方各省.
te: Attila leads a Hun army in the invasion of Italy, devastating the northern provinces as he heads for Rome.
dz: 阿提拉率领一支匈奴军队入侵了意大利,在他向罗马行进时摧毁了北方各省.
de: Attila leads a Hun army in the invasion of Italy, devastating the northern provinces as he heads for Rome.

t: 在叙利亚军团的支持下,埃拉加巴卢斯击败了皇帝麦克里努斯的军队.
te: With the support of the Syrian legions, Elagabalus defeats the forces of emperor Macrinus.
dz: 安提奥克战役:在叙利亚军团的支持下,埃拉加巴卢斯击败了皇帝麦克里努斯的军队.
de: Battle of Antioch: With the support of the Syrian legions, Elagabalus defeats the forces of emperor Macrinus.
